title: Condolence - Hisn al-Muslim 162
arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
transliteration: Inna lillāhi mā akhadh, wa lahu mā a`tā, wa kullu shay'in `indahu bi ajalin musammā . . . faltaṣbir wa 'l-taḥtasib.
translation: Surely, Allah takes what is His, and what He gives is His, and to all things He has appointed a time... so have patience and be rewarded.

title: Condolence - Alternative - Hisn al-Muslim 162
arabic: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ
transliteration: A`ẓamallāhu ajrak, wa 'aḥsana `azā'ak, wa ghafara limayyitik.
translation: May Allah magnify your reward, and make perfect your bereavement, and forgive your departed.
